name: scientific-figure-builder-reviewer
description: Initialize scientific-figure workflows, rebuild references as editable PowerPoint objects, and perform fail-closed final reviews.

interface.shortDescription: Initialize, rebuild, and audit scientific figures
interface.longDescription: A three-skill toolkit with whole-image workflow initialization, editable PowerPoint reconstruction from references, and an explicit read-only final audit.
defaultPrompt: Use $scientific-figure-initializer to initialize this figure workflow from my brief or draft.
Use $scientific-figure-builder to rebuild this reference with editable PowerPoint shapes.
Use $scientific-figure-reviewer to audit this PPT against its reference.
